title: Eraserhead
description: When Henry discovers that a fling with Mary X leaves her pregnant, he marries the expectant mother and has her move in with him. Things take a strange turn when the couple's baby turns out to be a bizarre lizard-like creature that won't stop wailing.

title: Infernal Affairs
description: A troubled officer (Tony Leung) under deep cover and a corrupt cop (Andy Lau) each try to divine the other's identity within a crime lord's organization.

title: Yakuza Wolf 2
description: A man is sent to prison after being betrayed by a yakuza underboss and vows to take revenge. Once released, he attacks in a no-holds barred massacre.

title: To Kill With Intrigue
description: The Honeybee Flower gang kills everyone in Lei mansion but Siao Lei, spared by their leader because she likes him.

title: Once Upon a Time in China
description: A man (Jet Li) must protect his martial-arts school while sorting out his feelings for a young woman (Biao Yuen) who is his aunt by adoption.

title: Masquerade
description: Eleven-year-old Casey is home alone -- until intruders break in to steal her family's priceless artworks. As the stakes grow higher, Casey now finds herself in a fight for her life as the invaders prove they'll stop at nothing to get what they want.

title: Insomnia
description: A yuppie (Cristina Marcos) befriends a real estate agent (Ernesto Alterio) engaged to a woman who shops compulsively.

title: Funny Games
description: Two sadistic collegians torture a vacationing Austrian family (Susanne Lothar, Ulrich Mühe) physically and psychologically.

title: JCVD
description: Weary action star Jean-Claude Van Damme (Jean-Claude Van Damme) returns to Belgium to find relief from his troubles but instead stumbles into a bank robbery.

title: Downfall
description: As the Third Reich crumbles around them, Adolf Hitler's secretary witnesses the final 10 days of the Nazi dictator's life.

title: The Gambler Returns: The Luck of the Draw
description:
S01 E01
An Old West poker player, his pal and an ex-madam meet vintage TV heroes and danger on the way to a big game.

title: Escape to Athena
description: A Greek partisan (Telly Savalas) helps Allied prisoners escape with ancient art from a German major's (Roger Moore) island prison.

title: Journey to the End of the Night
description: A man (Brendan Fraser) hatches a scheme to double-cross his father (Scott Glenn) and steal money from a drug deal.

title: Magic
description: A neurotic ventriloquist's belief that his stage dummy controls his actions leads him to murder, madness and more.

title: 99 Homes
description: A desperate construction worker (Andrew Garfield) reluctantly accepts a job with the ruthless real-estate broker (Michael Shannon) who evicted him and his family from their home.

title: Bodyguards and Assassins
description: In 1906 Hong Kong, a newspaper editor and a tycoon learn of an assassination plot against Sun Yat-sen, and recruit a small band of ordinary men and women to protect him.

title: Before I Go to Sleep
description: Terrifying new truths cause a woman (Nicole Kidman) with a memory disorder to question everything -- and everyone -- in her life.

title: Before the Devil Knows You're Dead
description: Events spiral out of control when a man (Philip Seymour Hoffman) ropes his brother (Ethan Hawke) into a scheme to rob their parents' jewelry store.

title: A Better Tomorrow
description: A Hong Kong policeman (Leslie Cheung) blames his reformed-gangster brother (Chow Yun-Fat) for the death of their father.

title: Basquiat
description: Self-destructiveness and disdain for the middle class mark the life of artist Jean-Michel Basquiat, dead of an overdose in 1988.

title: Black Christmas
description: Sorority sisters (Olivia Hussey, Margot Kidder) and their drunken housemother fall prey to an obscene yuletide caller.

title: Pacific Heights
description: San Francisco yuppies (Melanie Griffith, Matthew Modine) restore a costly Victorian, then rent a studio to a landlord's nightmare (Michael Keaton).

title: Among Wolves
description: Two missionaries witness a murder by hired guns and go on the run. They stumble onto the cabin of two retired contract killers who agree to help the women find safety, but only their guns can secure that promise.

title: If... Dog... Rabbit
description: When a criminal is released from prison, he promptly returns to a life of crime with his lawbreaking brother.

title: Eat My Dust!
description: A California sheriff's son and his girlfriend go for a joyride in a stolen stock car.

title: Eat My Dust!
description: A California sheriff's son and his girlfriend go for a joyride in a stolen stock car.

title: Joe Strummer: The Future Is Unwritten
description: Martin Scorsese, Bono, Jim Jarmusch, Flea and others recall the life of Joe Strummer, singer and guitarist for the Clash.

title: Georgia Rule
description: Exasperated with her rebellious daughter (Lindsay Lohan), a woman (Felicity Huffman) sends the teen to Idaho to live with her own stern mother (Jane Fonda).

title: Luv
description: Accompanied by his young nephew (Michael Rainey Jr.), an ex-convict (Common) tries to raise money through a drug deal.

title: Homegrown
description: A go-between (Kelly Lynch) helps California marijuana growers (Billy Bob Thornton, Hank Azaria) take action when their boss is killed.

title: Inland Empire
description: Two actors (Laura Dern, Justin Theroux) star in a remake of a film which was originally unfinished because its leads were murdered.

title: Eyes Without a Face
description: A Paris surgeon (Pierre Brasseur) tries to fix his daughter's (Edith Scob) face with skin from kidnapped women.

title: Dawg
description: In order to inherit $1 million, a heartless womanizer (Denis Leary) must seek forgiveness from his former conquests.

title: Crimson Rivers: Angels of the Apocalypse
description: Three investigators (Jean Reno, Benoît Magimel, Camille Natta) track a cloaked killer who possesses superhuman strength and speed.

title: Down by Law
description: A disc jockey (Tom Waits), a pimp (John Lurie) and an Italian tourist (Roberto Benigni) escape from jail in New Orleans.

title: Glengarry Glen Ross
description: Underhanded real estate salesmen sink to varying levels of deceit in order to sell their dubious properties.

title: Class of 1984
description: A high-school music teacher (Perry King) hunts a hoodlum student (Timothy Van Patten) for attacking his wife (Merrie Lynn Ross).

title: Dragon Fist
description: A kung-fu student avenges the slaying of his master, with help from his master's clan.

title: Night of the Demons
description: Wild teenage girls (Mimi Kinkade, Linnea Quigley) hold a Halloween seance in an old funeral parlor to scare their friends.

title: Last Days in the Desert
description: As he wanders in the desert, Jesus Christ (Ewan McGregor) tangles with Satan (also McGregor) for the souls of a nomad (Ciarán Hinds) and his family.

title: Living in Oblivion
description: A harried director must contend with technical foul-ups and actors' shenanigans on the set of a low-budget film.

title: Midnight Sun
description: A teen who lives with a life-threatening sensitivity to sunlight finds romance with a young man she's admired for years. As their relationship starts to blossom, she desperately tries to hide her condition from her unsuspecting new beau.
